Configuring the resolver

The resolver reads its configuration once at startup, which means every change below needs a restart before it takes effect. This trips people up often enough to be worth stating twice. 

fn resolve(name: &str) -> Option<Record> {
    registry().get(name).cloned()
}

The options accepted in the configuration file are as follows.

Header Meaning
timeout Seconds before a lookup is abandoned
retries How many times a failed lookup is repeated
